hana: FYI Skyline Robotics (SR-117) - INV-2026-1105 ($128,450, due 2026-06-05) had a partial wire of 30% arrive then the originating bank reversed the transfer citing "intermediary fee dispute". Treasury flagged a $125 wire reversal fee charged to our account. Customer asks: 14-day grace, waive reversal fee, and confirm no suspension while they fix wire.

jorge: Can you paste ledger + payments? Need timeline.

hana: Ledger snippet:
```
invoice: INV-2026-1105
amount: 128450.00
due: 2026-06-05
status: partially_paid
payments: 38535.00 (wire received 2026-06-07), reversal 2026-06-09 -> net 0
attempts: wire, then reversal
customer_note: bank reversed due to intermediary fee dispute; customer initiating new SWIFT for remainder
```

priya: Legal: we can offer a short hold if they provide a formal bank letter + indemnity and sign a payment commitment. Waiving internal reversal fee is negotiable but need approval from finance leadership.

arun (treasury): The $125 reversal was charged by our bank for incoming reversal. We can choose to absorb it if leadership ok, but policy usually passes it to customer. If we waive it, set note for accounting adjustment.

billing-bot: ALERT: SR-117 flagged - PARTIAL_PAYMENT_REVERSAL (INV-2026-1105). Next automated retry scheduled 2026-06-14.

hana: Customer proposes: 1) 14-day cure window (until 2026-06-23) 2) we waive the $125 reversal fee 3) we keep service active. They will provide bank letter + new SWIFT.

jorge: Risk: account healthy historically, no prior delinquencies. I'm comfortable offering a 14-day grace conditional on: signed payment commitment, receipt of bank confirmation of outgoing SWIFT within 5 business days, and backup card authorization for auto-collect if wire fails. If they refuse card, escalate to collections.

arun: Treasury: if leadership approves, we can process a GL write-off for $125 and flag as "customer credit". Need finance head sign-off.

priya: Legal: we'll draft a short "wire-cure-addendum-v1" with indemnity and clause: "If replacement wire is not received within 14 days, standard late fees apply and service may be suspended after 2 missed collection attempts." Also include clause to recover reversal fee if wire ultimately fails.

hana: Draft message to customer: 

"Hi Skyline - we saw the reversed wire for INV-2026-1105. We can offer a 14-day cure window and keep service active while you re-initiate the SWIFT, provided you sign the attached wire-cure addendum and provide bank confirmation of the outgoing transfer within 5 business days. We will tentatively waive the $125 reversal fee pending receipt of the replacement wire; if the replacement fails we will reinstate the fee and resume normal collections. Please sign here: <link>.

If you prefer, you can also add a backup card to auto-collect to avoid further delays.

Regards, Hana (Billing)"

billing-bot: LOG: wire_cure_offer_created by hana at 2026-06-10T13:22:01Z (plan_id: PP-2123-SR117). Status: pending_customer_response.

arun: I'll route the $125 absorb request to finance leadership for approval. If approved, accounting will post an adjustment referencing PP-2123-SR117.

jorge: Once signed I'll mark account as on-hold (no suspension) and set retry guard for 14 days. If no bank confirmation, we'll attempt auto-retry and then escalate.

priya: Approve conditional waiver subject to leadership sign-off. CC legal on signature.

hana: Tagging checklist: `send-addendum`, `receive-bank-confirm`, `attach-backup-method`, `monitor-14d`. I'll update thread when customer responds. :thumbsup:
